title: ControlHub — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Drawing Set. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Drawing Set
options.lineage: ISO / ANSI engineering drawing sheets: line-type conventions, title block, revision table
options.thesis: Your system drawn as a controlled engineering sheet: solid lines observed, dashed lines inferred, every change a numbered revision.
options.viewport: A full-width drawing sheet: the 7-service demo system plotted as a service diagram, a scrubbable time scale ruled along the bottom edge, and the title block (headline, scope, Open app) in the lower right.
options.risk: A light sheet is bright during night incidents, and the map renderer must be recoloured for a light ground.

raised.raise: Scrubbing the time scale ghosts the prior state and inks only what changed, like successive revisions of one sheet.
Two inks plus film, nothing else: black for observed fact, blue for inferred, red only for change and fault.
The same scrub always replots the same sheet: replay reads as a reproducible plot, not an animation.
Approval is a signature in the revision table: a plan's row inks in only when the second reviewer signs.

options.label: Signal Box Panel
options.lineage: railway NX route-setting panels and interlocking mimic diagrams
options.thesis: The system as a signal-box panel: services as track sections, live requests as lit routes, and no lever throws unless the interlocking allows it.
options.viewport: A dark enamel panel spanning the viewport: the demo topology as a mimic diagram with routes lighting as requests run, the headline on an engraved plate, Open app as a route-set button.
options.risk: A dark control room is close to where most runs in this category land, and glowing lamps can tip into a skeuomorphic toy.

options.label: Segment Display
options.lineage: seven-segment clocks, price totems and scoreboards
options.thesis: Time as the hero: every timestamp and count set in one segment mask where unlit cells show what is absent.
options.viewport: A giant segment readout of the replay cursor time that the visitor scrubs, with the service map below replotting to match.
options.case: Holds product clarity (time first, absence drawn honestly); loses audience identification, the scoreboard reads consumer.
options.risk: Digits everywhere become a gimmick beyond the hero.

options.label: Glyph Render
options.lineage: ASCII live renders on a phosphor terminal
options.thesis: The live map rendered as a glyph field: the system drawn in text, which is what telemetry is.
options.viewport: The demo topology as a live amber glyph field filling the viewport, the headline typed into the same grid.
options.case: Strong audience identification with terminal-native engineers; loses clarity, a glyph map hides observed vs inferred and status at a glance.
options.risk: Reads as retro-terminal novelty, and a glyph-rendered map is hard to make accessible.

options.label: Build Instructions
options.viewport: Numbered step spreads teaching how telemetry assembles into a map.
options.case: Loses both axes: engineers do not identify with toy instructions.
options.kept: Prior state ghosted, new state bright.
options.risk: Playful register undermines trust in an ops tool.

options.label: Riso Zine
options.thesis: Observed and inferred as two misregistered inks.
options.viewport: A two-ink cover with the map printed out of register.
options.case: Loses both axes: deliberate misregistration contradicts precise data.
options.risk: Misregistration reads as error in a monitoring tool.

options.label: Gravity Garden
options.thesis: Requests as rain falling along each service's pull.
options.viewport: A garden where request rain flows between service clouds.
options.case: Loses both axes: whimsy obscures what the product does.
options.kept: Deterministic replay as a visible law.

options.label: Kinetic Sand Glyphs
options.thesis: Commands as glyph rings that lock in relief.
options.viewport: A radial dial of actions rising from sand.
options.case: Loses both axes: radial ritual hides linear time and topology.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark observability dashboard landing, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Dark hero with a product screenshot and a grid of feature cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Grafana or Datadog clones, and close to the current look.
